# Uri.Combine

```m
Uri.Combine(baseUri as text, relativeUri as text) as text
```

Returns an absolute URI that is the combination of the input `baseUri` and `relativeUri`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUri` | `text` | no |
| `relativeUri` | `text` | no |
